Build and maintain the company's ClickUp workspace — production pipelines, dashboards, automations, SOPs, onboarding checklists

Monitor daily standups from all team members — flag anyone who didn't post or is behind on output

Track KPIs weekly for every team member and compile a CEO report: who's hitting, who's behind, what's stuck

Maintain and update SOPs — when a process changes, the doc gets updated the same day

Onboard new hires — set up their accounts, walk them through the systems, make sure they have everything they need to start producing on day 1

Keep ClickUp clean — tasks in the right status, fields filled in, no concepts stuck in limbo

Identify bottlenecks — if concepts are piling up in a specific status, figure out why and flag it

Set up and maintain automations, reminders, and recurring reports

Coordinate across pods — make sure each pod has enough concepts in their queue, editors aren't sitting idle, nothing's blocked



Talent Acquisition (40%)



Constantly source, screen, and pipeline candidates for video editors, creative strategists, and designers

Post and refresh job listings across LinkedIn, Meta Ads, Upwork, OnlineJobs.ph

Run direct outreach and poaching campaigns — identify high-performers at competing DTC brands, connect on LinkedIn, warm them up for a consult call

Screen all applications — review portfolios, filter out anyone without direct response background

Coordinate paid test projects — send to qualified candidates, collect submissions, schedule scoring

Schedule consult calls and final interviews with the founder

Maintain a bench of 2-3+ pre-screened candidates per role at all times so we're never scrambling to hire

Manage a $1,000/month recruiting budget for job ads and outreach tools

Qualifications



Required:



2+ years in operations, project management, or team coordination at a DTC brand, ecommerce company, or digital marketing agency

Strong ClickUp experience — you've built workspaces, not just used them. Dashboards, automations, custom fields, docs

Experience with recruiting/talent sourcing — you've screened candidates and managed hiring pipelines

Highly organized and detail-oriented — you catch things other people miss

Strong written English — you'll be writing SOPs, posting jobs, and sending outreach messages

Comfortable working async across time zones

Self-starter who doesn't need to be told what to do — you see the gap and fill it



Preferred:



Experience in the supplement, health/wellness, or direct response advertising space

Familiarity with Meta Ads, creative production workflows, or performance marketing

Experience with Richpanel, Triple Whale, Zapier, or similar DTC tools

Experience poaching talent from competitors (LinkedIn outreach, networking)

Work Environment

Fully remote

Async-first communication (ClickUp + WhatsApp)

6-day work week (Sunday off)

You'll work directly with the founder and have visibility into every part of the business

Small, fast-moving team — no bureaucracy, no politics, just execution

What We Value

Speed over perfection — ship it, iterate later

Ownership — if it's your responsibility, you own it completely

Proactive communication — don't wait for someone to ask, flag it yourself

Data-driven decisions — track everything, report on numbers, make recommendations based on data

Direct communication — no fluff, no corporate speak, say what you mean

Hiring Process

Submit application: 

Interview with the founder

Offer + onboarding

Important



This is an intensive role. You will NOT be hand-held. On day 1 you'll get access to everything — ClickUp, tools, docs, team channels. After that, you figure it out. If you need access to something, ask and you'll get it. But nobody is going to walk you through every step. You see what needs to be done, you do it, you make things better. If that scares you, this isn't the role for you. If that excites you, apply.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
Quick Overview:

- Competitive base salary

- Full-time, in-house, fully remote, flexible PTO

- Fill out our application form to apply



About Us



QuietLab is a growing multi-eight-figure DTC sleep brand built on great products and great marketing. We deliver problem-solving sleep products that help people live longer and wake up with the energy they deserve.



The Opportunity



We're hiring a Recruitment Specialist to own our hiring pipeline end-to-end: sourcing, screening, and coordinating every hire from first touch to offer. You'll partner with hiring managers and the CEO to fill roles fast, without lowering the bar.



If you can spot real experience over rehearsed answers, and get excited about finding the person everyone else missed, this role is for you.



Responsibilities



1. Sourcing & Pipeline

- Build and manage pipelines for every open role, from specialist to senior leadership

- Actively source across LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and niche channels and not reply on inbound leads

- Write job posts and outreach that attract A-players

- Screening & Evaluation

- Run structured screening calls to filter for fit, motivation, and track record

- Use structured methods to get past generic answers and into real evidence

- Flag red flags and standout signals clearly, with reasoning a hiring manager can act on fast

- Share candidates with the hiring manager, with your assessment and recommendation



2. Coordination & Process

- Own the candidate experience end to end, from first touch to offer

- Coordinate interview stages, trial tasks, and scorecards with hiring managers and the CEO

- Keep every requisition moving. A stalled pipeline is a dropped ball



3. Organization & Compliance

- Keep the ATS and hiring docs clean, current, and audit-ready

- Manage multiple open roles at once with minimal supervision

- Know the hiring compliance basics for a remote, global team



Who You Are



- Fluent, accurate English, written and spoken

- Proven recruiting track record at high-growth companies; DTC, ecommerce, or startup experience preferred

- Reads people fast. You can tell a generic answer from real experience

- Owns full-cycle recruiting, not just sourcing or just screening

- Sells the opportunity with confidence, even to candidates who have options

- Resourceful and fast. Fills roles quickly without lowering the bar

- Thrives in high-volume, feedback-driven work

-Gets people excited about QuietLab before they've even met the team



What Success Looks Like



Week 1: Learn our hiring framework, scorecards, and open roles. Shadow screening calls and get  familiar with our tools.

Week 2: Master sourcing and outreach, building a strong candidate pipeline.

Week 3: Run screening calls independently and own sourcing-to-screening for at least one open role start to finish.

Week 4: Run full-cycle recruiting on multiple roles with minimal oversight, consistently delivering A-player shortlists.



Our Core Values



We believe that: "Rules are for people who have no values."



Integrity: We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. Trust is non-negotiable. 

Excellence: We aim for the top 1%. Good enough is never enough. 

High-Energy: We show up with passion and positivity in everything we do.

Customer Centricity: We work from the customer backwards. 

Urgency: We move fast, not with haste but with control. The deadline is always ASAP.

Simplicity: We challenge the status quo and strip the non-essential.



Hiring Process

1. Application through this link: 

2. Screening Call: quick fit check on background, tools, and availability

3. In-Depth Interview: craft, workflow, and decision-making

4. Offer Discussion

5. Onboarding

title: Digital Marketing Graphic Designer – Landing Pages, Ads & Slides
description:
We are Singapore’s fastest growing performance marketing agency seeking

Digital Marketing Graphic Designer – Landing Pages, Ads & Slides

(1 full-time, remote position available)



We are Singapore’s fastest-growing performance marketing agency helping speakers, coaches, and service-based businesses build and scale million-dollar offers through paid ads and sales systems.



We are looking for a high-performance Website / Funnel Graphic Designer who understands conversion-driven design, mobile-first layouts, and AI-powered design workflows.



This is not a typical graphic design role.



You will be responsible for creating designs that directly impact revenue, including landing pages, ad creatives, webinar slides, and funnel assets.



You will work closely with our media buyers, copywriters, and funnel builders to produce high-converting marketing assets.



?



Who This Role Is For

 • Thinks mobile-first

If you only design pretty graphics but do not understand marketing, this role will not be a good fit.



?

?

?

•?  ?Webinar slides

•?  ?Marketing campaigns



Experience in performance marketing or funnel design is highly preferred.



?



Personal Traits



We are looking for someone who is:

•?  ?Able to handle multiple projects simultaneously

title: Shopify Store + Hydration Label Designer
description:

This is an initial launch project, but there is strong potential for ongoing paid work as we introduce additional supplements and products.



THE BRAND DIRECTION:



RebelShell Performance is not meant to look like a typical hardcore bodybuilding supplement company.

We want a premium lifestyle + performance brand built around people who are always moving:

Training / gym

Sports

Running

Outdoor/adventure

Beach/surf lifestyle

Travel

Everyday active lifestyle

Think performance meets lifestyle.

Our visual direction is:

Black / dark premium aesthetic + bold typography + bright accent colors + high-energy lifestyle imagery.



WEBSITE MOCKUP PROVIDED

Please review the attached website concept before applying.

The mockup represents the overall direction we want for the website:

BUILT TO KEEP UP.

You do NOT need to copy the mockup pixel-for-pixel. We want someone who can take this concept, improve it where necessary and turn it into a polished, functional Shopify store.

Label Deliverables

1 master hydration label

4 finished flavor variations

Print-ready files

Editable source files

High-quality product mockups/renders for all 4 flavors

Reasonable revisions

The packaging needs to look premium enough to compete with established supplement and hydration brands.

Please do NOT use a generic Canva-style supplement template.



2. SHOPIFY STORE

Build a professional Shopify store based on the attached RebelShell website mockup.

A quality FREE Shopify theme is completely fine.

We do NOT need complicated custom development.

We care about:

Visual quality, branding, mobile experience and making the company look legitimate from Day 1.

Store should include:

Homepage based on provided concept

Hydration product page

4 flavor variants

Product imagery/mockups

About Us

FAQ

Ingredients/Product Information

Contact page

Navigation + footer

Mobile optimization

Basic Shopify setup

Basic conversion-focused layout

The website and packaging should feel like one cohesive brand.

FUTURE OPPORTUNITY

Hydration is only our first launch product.

RebelShell Performance is being built as a broader performance/lifestyle supplement brand.

If we work well together, there may be additional paid projects involving:

Creatine

Pre-workout

Protein

Recovery products

Additional hydration flavors

Website updates

Advertising graphics

Social media creatives

New product mockups

We would prefer to find someone we can continue working with as the brand grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word REBEL so I know you read the complete posting.

Please send:

Your 3 best packaging/label designs

Your 3 best Shopify/e-commerce websites

Any supplement, fitness, beverage, sports or lifestyle brands you've worked with

What software you use for professional packaging design

Your estimated turnaround time

A few sentences explaining what you would do to improve or execute the attached RebelShell website concept

IMPORTANT

Strong design ability is our #1 priority.

We are NOT looking for someone who can simply install a Shopify theme and enter products.



We want someone with a strong visual eye who can take our existing concept and make RebelShell Performance feel like a real premium brand.



If you can deliver great packaging AND translate the same identity into a badass Shopify store, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Paid Media Specialist (Performance Marketing)
description:
Starting USD $1,000 – $1,400/month | Full Time | Remote | Hire by Sep 25 | Asia Time Zone



—



Are you a performance marketer who knows why the numbers moved, not just what they are?



Apply below to own real ad channels across Meta, TikTok, Google and more — with real budgets, real scale, and active coaching in AI workflows.







—



[1] About Care & Bloom



We launch and scale consumer health companies with $100M+ potential each. Built by operators who previously scaled IM8 (NASDAQ, $100M+ in 12 months), Casetify, and Peak21 — our flagship brand crossed 8-figure revenue and 1M+ customers in under 36 months. We are just getting started.



We are not hiring for roles — we are recruiting builders. People who have scaled revenue, shipped product, built things, broken things, and want to do it again — faster, with more resources, and alongside people who actually ship.



Check out our flagship brands: 
 · biird.co



—



[2] The Role



We took a brand from zero to $100M USD. Now we are adding firepower to the team that got us here.



This is a high-caliber, high-growth marketing team with ambitions to scale significantly further. We are adding paid media capacity — not to maintain what is running, but to push harder on what is already working and open up what is next.



As a Paid Media Specialist, you will own the performance of the ad channels we give you. You buy the media, watch the numbers every day, and tell the team what they mean and what to do next.



Leadership does not open the ad platforms. They read your report. That means your report has to be right every single day, and it has to come with a point of view, not just a set of figures.



For your first month or two you will bring your recommendations to the marketing lead for approval. Once you have shown you can read the numbers, you optimise on your own.



—



[3] What You Will Do



What you own:



- How your channels perform — manage spend, create and manage ad accounts, set up replacements when one gets rejected, flag billing before a lapse stops campaigns

- The daily report — build and maintain it across every funnel. Leadership never opens the ad platforms; they read your report. It has to be right every day

- How agency content performs — get it live as ads on time and own how it does once running

- Keeping accounts alive — our product category is high risk for ad and account bans. Monitor policy changes, spot risk early, act before a channel gets disrupted

- Spotting things first — flag underperformance, anomalies, or opportunities before anyone asks



What you work out:



- Analyze the data — not just what happened, but why, and what to do next

- Analyze creatives against performance and say what we should make more of

- Research what is working for other brands and competitors — landing pages, messaging, offers, campaign strategies. Bring back specific things we should test, and draft the advertorials yourself (AI tools welcome)

- Look beyond your own assignment — check what is happening on other channels so you understand the whole picture



What you run day to day:



- Launch ads at volume across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola and Google — several hundred a week, mostly through bulk tools

- Work with our internal creative team and external agencies on what is coming and when

- Work directly with platform reps on rejections, approvals, and questions



—



[4] What Success Looks Like at 90 Days



- Your channels are growing — spend and revenue up, ROAS held at target

- You have a repeatable way to test creatives and consistently find and scale winners

- Nothing has stopped — no campaign down from billing lapse, rejected account, or missed policy change

- Your reports are trusted — leadership d
 off them without checking platforms

- You are bringing ideas, not just numbers



—



[5] What We Are Looking For



- You understand how paid ads work on at least one platform — not just uploading, you know what to check, what to look at, and why. This is the one thing we cannot train from zero

- Initiative — you see what needs doing and you do it. We can tell within a week

- You ask questions constantly — we would rather you ask ten times a day than stay quiet and hand in a report with mistakes

- You treat the work as yours — the people who do well here push because they spotted the opportunity, not because someone asked

- Strong attention to detail — accuracy in the data, polish in the presentation

- Open to working on any platform — Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola, Google

- Comfortable with bulk launch tooling like AdManage or Revealbot, or able to pick it up fast

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and numbers

- Has used AI tools in their workflow (preferred, not required)

- Agency or in-house media buying experience is a plus



One thing this role is not: you will not be designing creatives. Our internal team and agencies produce the assets. You shape what they make by telling them what the data says is working, and you will write advertorials yourself.



If you have read this far: open your video by naming which of our six platforms you have actually run ads on, and which you have never touched. Be honest. Nobody has all six, and we would rather know now.



—



[6] Schedule



5 days a week, 8am to 5pm Philippine time. Your two days off include one weekday, so one of your five working days falls on a weekend and the team always has coverage. We will confirm which days when we assign your channels.



If we ask you to cover a sixth day, that is overtime.



—



[7] What You Will Get



- Attractive starting rate and grow fast — starting at USD $1,000 – $1,400/month

- Two weeks of one-on-one walkthrough training with the marketing lead

- Paid subscriptions to the tools you need

- Direct access to global founders and operators who have scaled brands past 8 figures

- Mentorship and clear growth paths

- Real spend across six platforms on brands that are scaling — a track record you can point at later

- Fully remote setup

- Asia Time Zone

- Work that truly matters — every report you build drives real revenue decisions for global brands



—



[8] HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application here:







You will be asked to:



- Upload your CV or LinkedIn profile

- Record a short Loom video (2-3 mins) covering:

- Which of our six platforms you have actually run ads on, and which you have never touched

- Your relevant paid media or marketing experience

- Why you are interested in this role



In the video, also answer this:



Last 7 days, three ads:



- Ad A: $120 spent, 1 purchase, $95 revenue

- Ad B: $2,400 spent, 41 purchases, $4,300 revenue

- Ad C: $310 spent, 6 purchases, $680 revenue



Which one would you scale, and why? A minute is plenty. We are listening for how you think, not how polished you are. It is the main thing we shortlist on.



Applications sent outside this link will not be reviewed.

title: Client Sales & Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Client Sales & Scheduling Coordinator



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time

$1,200 USD/month 



Hi! We’re The Haus Keepers, a growing home cleaning company based in Denver, Colorado. 



We’re looking for someone warm, sharp, organized, and naturally good at thinking through situations to join our front-end team.



This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant role where you’ll simply be given a list of tasks to complete.



You’ll be one of the first people our clients and potential clients interact with so we need someone who can communicate genuinely, notice details, think ahead, and use good judgment when every situation doesn’t have an exact script.



We can teach you our systems, processes, and standards.



What is much harder to teach  and what we care about most is how you think.



We’re looking for someone who naturally notices when something doesn’t make sense, looks for the information they need before acting, follows things through to completion, and doesn’t need a manager to make every small decision for them.



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll work closely with our front-end manager and help keep the client-facing side of the business running smoothly.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Answering incoming calls, texts,
s, and inquiries

* Speaking with potential clients and helping them choose the right cleaning service

* Booking new clients and following up with leads

* Managing scheduling, reschedules, cancellations, and appointment changes

* Reviewing upcoming appointments and catching potential problems before they affect a client

* Making sure important client information and preferences are properly documented

* Following up on conversations and making sure nothing gets acknowledged but forgotten

* Helping recurring clients with questions and account changes

* Listening and responding warmly when a client is frustrated or upset

* Gathering the right context before handing more serious client concerns to our Client Experience & Retention Manager

* Coordinating with other team members when something affects scheduling or service

* Looking for patterns, gaps, or opportunities to improve how we operate



You will not be expected to solve every problem alone.



We have separate team members who own client recovery/retention and contractor operations. But we do expect you to recognize when something needs attention, gather the right information, handle what belongs in your lane, and escalate thoughtfully when needed.



The Person We’re Looking For



You may be a great fit if you are someone who:



* Communicates warmly and naturally with people

* Is comfortable talking with U.S.-based clients over the phone

* Can confidently help a potential client move toward booking without being pushy

* Notices small details that other people sometimes miss

* Thinks about what might happen next instead of only completing the task in front of you

* Investigates before making assumptions

* Can make reasonable decisions independently

* Knows when something truly needs to be escalated

* Keeps excellent notes and follows through on unfinished items

* Can prioritize when several things need attention at once

* Takes feedback well and actually applies it the next time a similar situation happens

* Speaks up when you see a recurring problem or a better way to do something

* Enjoys being trusted with responsibility



We do not expect perfection.



We do expect someone who thinks, learns, asks good questions, and becomes increasingly independent as they understand the business.



Experience



Experience in customer service, sales, scheduling, operations, hospitality, home services, or another client-facing service business is strongly preferred.



Experience with a residential cleaning company is a big plus.



Experience with tools such as Booking Koala, OpenPhone/Quo, GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, ClickUp, or similar systems is also helpful, but none of those are required.



We are currently transitioning from some of our existing systems into our own software so you should be comfortable learning new technology and adapting as systems evolve.



Schedule



This is a full-time position.



Monday–Friday

8:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time

40 hours per week



You must be consistently available during these hours.



Compensation



$1,200 per month, Paid twice monthly on 1st and 15th



What It’s Like Working With Us



We care deeply about our clients, but we also care about the people on our team.



We want people to feel trusted rather than micromanaged.



Our culture is very outcome-focused. We care about whether things are being handled well, clients are being taken care of, follow-ups are happening, and problems are being caught, not whether someone looks busy every second of the day.



You’ll have clear expectations and support but we also want you to eventually become someone your manager can trust without needing to check behind everything you do.



We love people who take ownership, bring ideas forward, and genuinely care about doing good work.



How to Apply



Please complete our application here: 



We’re excited to meet you! 💛



The Haus Keepers

title: $10/hr Video Editor & Content Creative - Christian Media
description:
ONGOING RATE: $10/hour equivalent after a successful paid pilot.

PAID PILOT RATE: $8/hour equivalent.



Kainos is looking for a thoughtful, dependable Video Editor & Content Creative in the Philippines to help us create deeply researched Christian media for tired servant leaders. You can read more about our mission at 



The internet has endless 45-minute podcasts. We want to make something rarer: carefully crafted videos that turn substantial books, research, church history, Scripture, and complex ideas into precise, accessible content. A 16-hour book might become a series of several concise videos containing its strongest ideas. Our goal is greater depth, nuance, charity toward differing Christian views, and appreciation for mystery—not sensationalism, tribalism, or oversimplification.



This is a remote, flexible, project-based independent-contractor engagement. Most communication will be asynchronous, so you may organize your own schedule and work from wherever you choose. We anticipate roughly 10–20 hours of project work per week as our publishing cadence grows, but work will be scoped as deliverables rather than fixed shifts.



WHAT YOU WILL HELP CREATE



- Edit long-form YouTube videos from scripts, narration, creative direction, and feedback

- Develop short-form videos that feel native to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and perhaps
—not merely clipped long-form content

- Bring ideas to life through pacing, visual storytelling, illustration, typography, sound design, and music

- Help craft strong thumbnails

- Prepare, publish, and monitor content across platforms

- Keep project files, source files, assets, and licenses organized

- Learn and improve creative workflows that may include AI-assisted image, music, and sound-effect tools while avoiding generic “AI-slop” aesthetics

- Suggest better systems and creative approaches when you see them; the best idea wins



YOU MAY BE A STRONG FIT IF YOU



- Care about serving the global church and its leaders through excellent creative work

- Are comfortable faithfully editing explicitly Christian content involving Scripture, church history, and Christian belief

- Have strong written English comprehension and can communicate clearly through Discord, comments, and project tools; perfect spoken English is not required

- Are self-motivated, dependable, responsive, and able to manage your own time

title: Social Media Trend Report
description:
Gig: Social Media Trend Report For Female Founder Account



Fixed price: $100 · Estimated 8–10 hours · 7-day turnaround · Potential for longer-term hire 



Context



I'm a founder building a content brand that teaches early-stage female founders marketing, storytelling, and fundraising. Before I post anything, I want to understand what's actually working — not vibes, evidence.



I care about what works for accounts starting from near zero, because that's my situation. A post that performs for someone with two million followers won't perform as well with an account with 100 followers.



Two deliverables: a sourced account list, and one spreadsheet. That's it.



Deliverable 1: Source the accounts



This is most of the value. I don't have a list for you — finding the right accounts is the job.



Find 10 founder accounts in the 1,000–15,000 follower range who post regularly about building their business. Priority order:



Physical product and DTC founders — apparel, footwear, beauty, food. People showing manufacturing, sampling, sourcing, packing orders, unit costs, launches. Closest to my own business.

Female founders teaching GTM, marketing, or fundraising to other founders.

Bootstrapped founders documenting the build honestly, including what isn't working.



Where to look — hand-sourcing, not a Google search:



- TikTok and Instagram hashtag and keyword search: #smallbusinessowner, #founderlife, #buildinpublic, #dtcbrand, #productdevelopment, #firstorder, #samplemaking and other key words

- Comment sections of larger founder accounts — people asking smart questions are often building something

- "Suggested for you" chains off accounts that match

- Sounds and audio pages where founder content clusters



Requirements: posted at least 8 times in the last 90 days · followers roughly 1k–15k · actually the founder, not a brand account, agency, or a coach with no company.



Deliver: handle, platform, follower count, what they build, posting frequency, one line on why they qualify.



Send me this list by day 2 for approval before you start logging. I don't want you analysing the wrong accounts for five days.



A note on method: do not ask an AI to generate this list. I've tried — it returns real founders with invented content strategies attached. Every account must be one you opened and looked at.



Deliverable 2: The spreadsheet



For each of the 10 approved accounts, log two sets of posts from the last 90 days:



Top 10 performers — their best by engagement

Worst 10 performers — their weakest



Measure "worst" against that account's own median, not absolute numbers. A 2,000-view post is a flop for one account and a hit for another. I want their misses relative to their own normal.



Columns

Column What goes in it

Account Handle

Platform Instagram / TikTok

Set Top / Bottom

Date Post date

Link Direct link

Format Reel / carousel / static / text post

Sub-format Tutorial, listicle, hot take, story, day-in-life, before/after, teardown, Q&A

Production level Phone selfie / talking head with lighting / b-roll edit / text-on-screen static / voiceover over footage / walk-and-talk

Theme See below

Hook type Question / number / contrarian claim / callout / story open / demonstration

Hook text First line or first 3 seconds, transcribed, not paraphrased

CTA type Comment-to-DM / link in bio / follow / none

Views · Likes · Comments · Shares Where visible

Notes Your analysis — see below

On themes



Use consistent labels throughout so the sheet can be sorted and counted. That's the whole point — I need to filter by theme and see which subjects actually resonate.



Start with something like: AI tools and workflows · manufacturing and sourcing · unit economics and pricing · fundraising · GTM and customer acquisition · personal brand and storytelling · revenue transparency · industry news and hot takes · founder mental health · customer stories · contrarian anti-advice.



Add or merge categories if the content calls for it — just apply them consistently and give me the final list of labels you used. Don't invent a new label for every post.



On the notes column — this is the real deliverable



One to three sentences per post on why you think it worked or didn't. This column is why I'm hiring a person instead of scraping the data.



Good notes look like: "Hook names a specific dollar figure in the first two seconds and the payoff is delayed to the end — comments are people arguing about the number, which is what drove reach."



Or: "Bottom-set post. Same creator, same format as their top performer, but the hook is a generic 'let's talk about branding' with no stakes. Nothing to react to."



Bad notes: "Good engagement." "Nice visuals." "Trending audio."



Where the same account appears in both sets with a similar format, say what changed. That comparison is the most useful thing in the sheet.



On metrics



Small accounts also have noisy data. One post can spike because someone bigger shared it. Flag outliers in the notes rather than letting them look like a pattern.



Standards and working with AI 



AI is a tool, not the author. Use it for transcription and sorting. The notes column must be yours and traceable to a post I can open. Notes that read like unedited model output are an automatic no.



Specific over safe. Every note should say something that couldn't be said about a different post.



Google Sheets, comment access on.



To apply



- Submit three nano founder accounts you found (1k–15k followers, posting about building a physical product business). Include the handle, follower count, and one line on what makes them worth watching, and how you found them.

- One post from one of them, with the notes you'd write for it. Three sentences max.



That's the whole interview. If you can source those accounts and write that note, you can do this job.

title: Performance Video Editor (Meta Ads) - Travel DTC Brand
description:
Read this part first



This is a high output role. Before anything else, here is the standard:



- 5 concepts per week minimum, each with 3 hook variations

- One new ad per day with variations, sustained

- A 90 second B-roll video sourced and edited in a day



If that pace sounds unreasonable to you, we are not a fit and you should not apply. I would rather you find that out now than in week three.





Who we are



I started this brand 8 months ago while working full time as a software engineer. I scaled it to 7 figures doing customer support and creative strategy myself. A few weeks ago I quit and went all in. Revenue is up 80 percent in my first month full time.



We sell in the travel space, mostly to the US. Almost everything we have scaled on so far has been static ads. We are now building the video ad library close to from scratch, and that is what this seat is for.





Why this seat exists



I already have two editors on the team. The constraint is not ideas or briefs, it is finished ads reaching the account. I write the briefs and scripts, and there are more of them ready than we are getting made.



So there is no shortage of work waiting for you here, and nothing for you to sit around waiting on either. What we need is throughput.



I am not looking for someone to hand tasks to and chase. I am looking for someone who raises the standard of how we work. Someone who sees a slow, stupid part of the workflow and fixes it instead of working around it for three weeks. If you come in and set the pace everyone else measures themselves against, you will do very well here.





What you will be doing



- Editing B-roll driven video ads for Meta, mostly 90 seconds to 2 minutes, occasionally up to 3

- Producing 5 concepts a week at a minimum, 3 hook variations each 

- Sourcing and generating your own B-roll from the brief

- Working from real performance data. You will be in the ad account and see what wins and what dies

- Static ad design when it is needed. Not the main job, but a real plus if you can do it





What you need



- Proven experience editing direct response video ads. 

- You can source, cut and deliver a 90 second B-roll ad within a day

- You work from a script and a brief without rewriting the strategy

- You can read performance data and act on it. You look at what an ad did, work out why, and your next version reflects that. This is not optional, it is how we improve

- You write and communicate clearly. Learnings, feedback, what you tried and why. Short and sharp, not essays

- Comfortable in a fast feedback loop with blunt notes

- Reliable daily availability and honest communication about what is done and what is not





Strong bonus



- AI generated B-roll. If you are good at this, say so clearly. It is one of the highest value skills for this role

- You can write your own direct response ads. If you can bring your own angles and scripts rather than only executing mine, that changes what this role becomes and what it pays

- AI animation

- Static ad design for Meta





Compensation



Base up to $2,500 USD per month, depending on experience.



Performance bonus of 4 percent of the ad spend on the ads you build. You are paid your base or your bonus, whichever is higher that month. It is uncapped.



A strong month already puts you above base. As the account scales that number keeps growing with no ceiling on it. The better your ads perform, the more spend they take, and the more you make. Your incentive and mine point in the same direction.



This is not a bonus that only exists on paper. Ads are attributed to whoever built them, tracked in the ad account, and paid monthly.





What you get working with me



- Direct access. No manager and no ticket queue. You work with me, in the ad account, on the strategy

- Tools that remove the grunt work. I build the internal tooling for this brand, including a searchable database of real customer language and pain points, so you are not starting from a blank canvas

- Funded learning. Tools, courses, subscriptions. If it makes you better, I will pay for it

- Real feedback. You will know exactly why something won or lost





Do not apply if



- You need everything spelled out twice

- You are stacking this on top of other clients

- Your reason for a missed deadline is always something outside your control

- You need four days to produce one video





How to apply



Apply here with a Loom of 2 to 3 minutes. Talk me through:



- One direct response video ad you edited and why you made the choices you made

- One ad of yours that underperformed, what you concluded from it, and what you changed next

- Your typical turnaround for a 90 second B-roll ad

- Whether you have generated B-roll with AI, which tools you used, and how it went



If you are shortlisted:



- A call with me, so we both work out whether this is a fit

- A paid test project. A 90 second B-roll ad from a script I provide, 24 hour turnaround. You are paid for it whether or not you get hired



No Loom and no ads means no review. The Loom is not optional. I want to hear how you think, not only see the final cut.

Logic Minds is an Australian company committed to building long-term relationships with our customers, suppliers, and staff. We believe strong relationships are built through trust, accountability, responsiveness, and consistently delivering high-quality work from end to end.

Our aim is to create sustainable partnerships that provide value to our customers while maintaining high standards across our suppliers, processes, and services.



Logic Minds is built around five key pillars: 

Reducing our clients’ expense bases

1. Sourcing sustainable products and services that support long-term relationships

2. Never compromise on quality

3. Future-proofing company processes by implementing scalable controls and processes

4. Respect, Respond and React to all customer needs

________________________________________



ABOUT THE ROLES  

Logic Minds is seeking an experienced and proactive Vendor Management & Transactional Procurement staff to join our team in a work-from-home capacity.

This role will be responsible for managing and strengthening relationships with suppliers and vendors while ensuring Logic Minds consistently achieves the best combination of cost, quality, service, reliability, and value.

This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is highly organised, process-driven, and confident in communicating with both vendors and senior stakeholders.

The successful candidate will work closely with suppliers, internal stakeholders, customers, and senior executives to ensure vendor relationships are effectively managed, and that agreed standards, pricing, service levels, and quality requirements are consistently met.

The ideal candidate will also be comfortable working independently from home, managing competing priorities, identifying issues before they become problems, and taking ownership of finding practical solutions.



CORE VALUES

The successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate Logic Minds’ core approach in every aspect of their work:

• RESPECT

Treat customers, suppliers, colleagues, and stakeholders with professionalism and respect.

• RESPOND

Communicate promptly, clearly, and professionally.

• REACT

Take action, solve problems, and follow matters through to completion.

KEY PERFORMANCE OUTCOMES 

Success in this role will be measured by the individual’s ability to:

• Build and maintain strong, reliable vendor relationships.

• Achieve competitive pricing and measurable cost savings where appropriate.

• Maintain high supplier performance and quality standards.

• Resolve vendor and customer issues quickly and effectively.

• Ensure vendor documentation and records are accurate and up to date.

• Maintain strong communication with Australian clients, suppliers, and senior stakeholders.

• Identify and implement process improvements.

• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Consistently meet deadlines and agreed deliverables.

• Work independently while keeping management appropriately informed.

• Contribute to scalable and sustainable vendor management processes.

• Support Logic Minds’ commitment to Respect, Respond and React to customer needs.



________________________________________



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

1. Vendor & Supplier Relationship Management

• Develop and maintain strong, professional relationships with vendors and suppliers.

• Act as a key point of contact for vendor-related matters.

• Communicate regularly with suppliers to maintain strong working relationships and ensure expectations are clearly understood.

• Manage supplier queries, concerns, escalations, and service issues promptly and professionally.

• Build long-term supplier partnerships aligned with Logic Minds’ business objectives.

• Ensure suppliers understand and consistently meet agreed requirements and expectations.



2. Pricing, Quotes & Cost Management 

• Source and obtain competitive supplier pricing, quotes, and proposals.

• Review supplier pricing and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve value.

• Assist with price negotiations and commercial discussions with suppliers.

• Compare supplier quotes and assess overall value, not simply price.

• Monitor pricing changes and identify opportunities for savings.

• Maintain accurate records of pricing, quotes, supplier agreements, and relevant commercial information.

• Support Logic Minds’ objective of reducing clients’ expense bases through effective supplier management.



3. Vendor Performance & Quality Management 

• Monitor supplier performance against agreed expectations, service levels, quality standards, and delivery requirements.

• Identify recurring vendor performance issues and implement appropriate corrective actions.

• Follow up with suppliers to ensure issues are resolved within agreed timeframes.

• Escalate significant or ongoing supplier issues to management when required.

• Maintain accurate vendor performance records and documentation.

• Ensure quality is never compromised in the pursuit of cost savings.



4. Vendor Compliance & Process Management

• Ensure vendor documentation, agreements, pricing, and other relevant records are current and accurately maintained.

• Assist in implementing and maintaining effective vendor management processes and controls.

• Ensure vendor-related procedures are followed consistently.

• Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and risks and recommend improvements.

• Help develop scalable processes that can support the future growth of Logic Minds and its clients.

• Maintain organised and accurate vendor records and documentation.



5. Reporting & Data Management

• Maintain accurate vendor databases, spreadsheets, reports, and records.

• Prepare regular reports relating to supplier performance, pricing, costs, savings, and other relevant vendor metrics.

• Use Excel to analyse vendor data and identify trends, discrepancies, cost-saving opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Ensure vendor information is accurate, current, and easily accessible.

• Provide management with clear and concise information to support decision-making.



6. Customer & Stakeholder Communication

• Work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to understand vendor-related requirements.

• Respond promptly and professionally to customer and stakeholder requests.

• Communicate effectively with Australian clients and senior executives.

• Manage sensitive or complex vendor and customer matters with professionalism and sound judgement.

• Ensure customer needs are respected, responded to, and acted upon in accordance with the Logic Minds values.



7. Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve vendor management processes.

• Investigate issues and determine practical, sustainable solutions.

• Look beyond immediate problems to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

• Recommend improvements to supplier processes, controls, and workflows.

• Support the ongoing development of efficient, scalable, and future-proof vendor management systems.

________________________________________



ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

The successful candidate must have:



Communication

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Strong professional communication and interpersonal skills.

• Confidence communicating with suppliers, customers, internal stakeholders, and senior executives.

• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with Australian clients.



Customer Service & Australian Client Experience

• Previous experience in customer service, account management, vendor management, procurement, administration, or similar role is given a priority.

• Demonstrated experience working directly with Australian clients or businesses.

• Strong understanding of professional expectations when dealing with Australian customers and stakeholders.

• Proven ability to manage customer and supplier relationships professionally.



Excel & Data Management

• Excellent Microsoft Excel skills are essential.

• Ability to confidently manage, analyse, organise, and report on large amounts of information.

• Strong attention to detail when working with spreadsheets, pricing, supplier data, and reports.

• Ability to use Excel to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement.



Vendor Management

• Experience managing suppliers, vendors, contractors, or external service providers.

• Experience handling supplier communication, quotes, pricing, negotiations, performance, and issue resolution.

• Strong ability to balance cost, quality, service, and supplier relationships.

________________________________________



PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES



Essential

The successful candidate will be:

• Self-motivated – able to maintain productivity and accountability while working remotely.

• Proactive – identifies issues and opportunities without always needing to be directed.

• Highly organised – able to manage multiple vendors, tasks, deadlines, and priorities.

• Independent – comfortable working autonomously from a home office.

• Confident – comfortable communicating with senior executives and experienced business stakeholders.

• Professional – demonstrates maturity and sound judgement when dealing with customers and suppliers.



Important

The successful candidate should also be:

• A fast learner who can quickly understand new systems, processes, products, and requirements.

• A strong problem solver who can investigate issues and develop practical solutions.

• Process-driven with a strong focus on consistency and accountability.

• Highly detail-oriented with excellent accuracy when managing vendor information, pricing, documentation, and reports.

• Commercially minded with an understanding of cost, value, quality, and supplier performance.

• Adaptable and able to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• A strong relationship builder who understands the importance of trust and long-term partnerships.

________________________________________



Work Requirements



Location

• Philippines

• Work From Home



Hours

• Full-time

• Monday to Friday

• Melbourne, Australia business hours

• 8:30am – 5:00pm Melbourne time (equivalent to 6:30 am – 3:00 pm Philippine time, subject to seasonal daylight savings changes)



Leave

• Holidays: 20 days paid holiday per year accrued

• Sick Leave: 10 days paid sick leave per year accrued, provided with a medical certificate

• Public Holidays: Australian Public Holidays



Equipment Required

• Reliable internet connection

• Modern computer/laptop

• Quality headset

• Quiet home office environment

• Backup internet/power supply required



Salary

o Probation 3-month period: 23,000 pesos

o After probation: 25,000 pesos

o Pay Cycle: 15th to 16th of each month, with salary paid on the 15th.

o Annual Increase: 1,000 PESO anniversary date

o Bonus: Additional Month Salary each DECEMBER (pro-rata). 

Note: 13th month bonus is only applicable to staff who are still with the company on month of December.



Put in INTERESTED in your message title to be considered.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Lifestyle Creator
description:
We are looking for a talented, creative video editor to work long-term with a growing female lifestyle and wellness creator with a large Instagram audience.



The majority of the content will be short-form vertical videos for Instagram Reels, with some content also being used for TikTok and other social platforms.



We are looking for someone who understands what makes social media content engaging — not just someone who knows how to use editing software.



**What you'll do:**



* Turn raw iPhone footage into polished, engaging Instagram Reels and short-form videos

* Create strong hooks and maintain fast, natural pacing

* Add captions, text, music, sound effects, B-roll, zooms, transitions, and other elements when appropriate

* Understand the creator's existing editing style and learn to replicate it consistently

* Help identify unnecessary parts of videos and tighten edits to improve retention

* Stay aware of current Instagram and TikTok editing trends

* Organize projects and deliver edits consistently and on time

* Make revisions based on feedback



The content focuses primarily on lifestyle, motherhood, wellness, beauty, food, fitness, and everyday life.



**We're looking for someone who:**



* Has significant experience editing Instagram Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts

* Has a strong sense of pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention

* Understands current social media trends

* Has excellent attention to detail

* Communicates well in English

* Is dependable and responds well to feedback

* Wants a consistent, long-term position rather than occasional freelance projects



Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar professional editing software is preferred.



**To apply:**



Please send:



1. A link to your portfolio.

2. The 3 short-form videos you have edited that you are most proud of.

3. Which editing software you primarily use.

4. Your current availability and how many hours per week you can work.

5. A short explanation of why you think you'd be a good fit for a female lifestyle/wellness creator.



**Important:** Please begin your application with the word **MOMMA** so we know you read the entire job description.



We will select a small number of candidates to complete a **paid editing test using real raw footage**. The best candidate will be offered an ongoing position.



We are looking for someone who can learn the creator's style extremely well and eventually become a trusted part of the content process.

title: Founding Experience & Innovation Architect
description:
About STACS



Shirley Therapeutic and Consulting Services (STACS) is a growing mental health, education, and emotional-awareness company built around a simple belief:



Understanding Changes Everything.



We are expanding beyond traditional therapy into digital products, educational resources, content platforms, subscriptions, trainings, AI-supported tools, and experiences that help people better understand themselves and their relationships.



We are looking for a Founding Experience & Innovation Architect to help turn those ideas into things people can actually see, use, experience, engage with, and purchase.



This is not simply a graphic design role.

It is not simply social media.

It is not an automation role.

And it is definitely not a role for someone who only enjoys brainstorming.



We are looking for a builder.



Big Ideas. Small Details. Both Matter Here.



Some days, you may be asked to explore an undeveloped idea, study our customer avatar, identify one or two viable concepts, recommend the strongest direction, and estimate what it would take to execute.



Other days, you may be:



* Creating a form or landing page

* Building or testing a GHL workflow

* Designing a digital resource in Canva

* Scheduling social media content

* Repurposing a podcast episode into social and written content

* Formatting or publishing a Substack article

* Uploading and organizing digital assets

* Testing links,
s, forms, funnels, or customer journeys

* Documenting a process or creating an SOP

* Researching a new AI or no-code tool

* Troubleshooting something that did not work as expected

* Helping move a subscription, digital product, or new experience toward launch



We consider both kinds of work important.



The right person brings the same care and energy to the seemingly ordinary details as they do to the exciting creative work.



Because at STACS, the small work is what makes the big ideas functional.



What You’ll Help Build



Our ecosystem includes developing and emerging initiatives such as The Fear Therapy Podcast, Substack, digital products and resources, subscription experiences, educational content, courses and workshops, AI-supported experiences, social media, customer journeys, and other STACS intellectual property.



You will work across three interconnected areas:



45% — Adaptive Execution & Ownership

You move work forward. You manage agreed timelines and milestones, identify obstacles early, research solutions, recommend next steps, execute approved directions, troubleshoot problems, and close loops.



40% — Creative Development & Production

You help transform ideas into polished experiences through design, content, social media, digital products, customer journeys, podcast and Substack support, landing pages, GHL experiences, and related creative production.



15% — Opportunity Translation & Executional Strategy

You help answer: “Given where STACS wants to go, what is a smart way to get there?” You may review an emerging technology, audience insight, Founder idea, or existing STACS concept and develop one or two practical ways it could become something useful—with a recommendation and projected execution timeline.



What Ownership Means Here



We do not expect you to know everything.



We do expect you to know what to do when you don’t.



When an obstacle appears, your first response should not be to stop working and wait indefinitely for instructions. We value people who can research possibilities, evaluate reasonable options, communicate what they find, recommend a next step, and identify what decision or support they need.



You will have access to leadership and collaborate with STACS Systems, Operations, and Customer Service functions.



You are not expected to replace those roles.



You are expected to understand how your work connects to them.



Our operating philosophy is simple:



Own the outcome. Create movement. Close the loop.



Innovation at STACS



Innovation does not mean chasing every shiny new platform. 



For us, innovation means turning useful ideas into testable experiences.



You should be comfortable moving through a process such as:



Research → Evaluate → Recommend → Prototype → Test → Implement → Improve



You may be given an article, video, new technology, audience observation, or partially developed Founder idea and asked:



“Is there something here for STACS?”



A strong response goes beyond “Yes, that’s a cool idea.”



We want someone who can study our audience and existing ecosystem, develop one or two viable applications, identify what would be required, recommend a direction, and provide a realistic projected timeframe for execution.



Content & Social Media



Social media is part of this role, but this is not a traditional Social Media Manager position.



You will help create, adapt, organize, schedule, and publish STACS content across appropriate channels while looking for ways to connect individual pieces of content into a larger ecosystem.



A podcast episode might become a Substack article, several social posts, an audience conversation, a resource, an
 journey, or eventually an idea for a product.



We want someone who can see those connections.



Tools & Technical Comfort



You do not need to be a software engineer.



You do need to be technologically curious, resourceful, and comfortable learning digital platforms.



Experience or strong working comfort with GoHighLevel (GHL) is important, particularly with functions such as landing pages, forms, funnels, workflows,
/SMS journeys, pipelines, and customer experiences.



You should also be comfortable with Canva, AI tools, automation/no-code platforms, social publishing tools, digital content platforms, and collaborative project-management environments.



Specific tools will continue to evolve.



Your ability to learn and apply technology matters more than collecting software certifications.



You May Thrive Here If…



You are someone who:



* Enjoys both creative thinking and practical execution

* Can take an idea from concept toward completion

* Notices details without losing sight of the larger objective

* Can work effectively while an organization is growing and changing

* Maintains momentum when plans, tools, or circumstances shift

* Researches before immediately asking someone else to solve the problem

* Can make thoughtful recommendations rather than simply presenting information

* Communicates clearly when you need a decision, resource, or clarification

* Is comfortable receiving Founder direction and figuring out how to execute it

* Can manage several different types of work without abandoning the less exciting assignments

* Takes pride in completing what was started

* Enjoys learning emerging technology

* Understands that beautiful experiences must also work

* Can support social media consistently rather than only when inspiration strikes



This Role May NOT Be for You If…



This section is important.



You may not enjoy this position if you primarily want to:



brainstorm but not execute; design but not document; build automations but avoid routine production; work only on highly creative assignments; wait for detailed step-by-step instructions before moving; or consistently lose interest once a project reaches the repetitive implementation stage.



STACS is intentionally looking for someone with range.



We dream big here.



Then we do the little things required to make the dream real.



Compensation & Schedule



This is a remote position. With the exclusion of established meetings, you are not tied to a specific time schedule. Your deadlines will always be EST.



The role also includes defined performance and project-based bonus opportunities tied to areas such as exceptional execution, innovation initiatives, successful product or experience launches, and measurable business impact.



Bonus opportunities are in addition to base compensation and will have predetermined expectations when applicable.



Importantly, higher-level creative or innovation work does not offset neglected core responsibilities. Consistent execution of routine responsibilities is required for bonus eligibility.



The position begins with a 90-day onboarding and evaluation period.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, we should begin to see something beyond completed assignments.



We should see movement.



Ideas become plans.

Plans become deliverables.

Problems come with possible solutions.

Content gets published.

Forms get built.

Experiences get tested.

Projects get closed.

And opportunities we might otherwise overlook begin turning into thoughtful recommendations.



You won’t be expected to transform STACS by yourself.



But we should be able to point to things that now exist, function better, or moved forward because you were here.



How to Apply:



When submitting your application, add the words “Dragonfly of Hope” to your subject line. Around here, the little things matter, too. 



Please submit your résumé/CV, relevant portfolio or work samples to: 
 and a brief response to the following:



1. Big Idea: Tell us about something you helped take from an idea to a completed experience, product, campaign, system, or launch. What did you personally own?



2. Small Detail: Tell us about a repetitive, administrative, or seemingly “boring” assignment you were responsible for. How did you maintain quality and consistency?



3. Problem-Solving: Tell us about a project that encountered an unexpected obstacle. What did you do before escalating the problem?



4. Opportunity Translation: Imagine you are given an emerging AI tool and asked, “Could STACS use this?” Walk us through how you would determine whether the idea is worth pursuing.



5. Technology: Briefly describe your experience with GoHighLevel, Canva, AI tools, automations, social media, and any other relevant digital platforms.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter & Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE CHANNEL

I'm building a YouTube channel focused on entertaining celebrity and pop-culture content, including tier lists, rankings, celebrity chemistry, relationships, comparisons, and other highly clickable concepts.



The style I'm looking for is similar to channels such as Tree Fuel and Binge Central.



The videos should be entertaining, fast-paced, and designed to keep viewers watching.



THE TWO MOST IMPORTANT SKILLS

1. YouTube Scriptwriting

2. YouTube Video Editing

These are the most important parts of this position. I am NOT looking for someone who is simply "okay" at writing and editing.



You should understand:

How to write a strong hook

How to keep viewers curious

How to structure a video for retention

How to avoid boring/filler sections

How to make celebrity/pop-culture topics entertaining

How to create natural transitions

How to use humor and storytelling

How to match visuals to the narration

RESPONSIBILITIES

Script

PORTFOLIO REQUIRED.

Please send:

Your 3 best YouTube videos that you edited

Your 2 best YouTube scripts

At least 3 thumbnails you've created

What editing software you use

How long you've been editing YouTube videos

How long you've been writing YouTube scripts

Your availability

Please start your application with:

"I CAN WRITE & EDIT."

Applications that do not include a portfolio will not be considered.



Potential to become long term employment

title: Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor
description:
Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor



We’re looking for a driven Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor who wants to grow with our team long-term.



Your main responsibility will be editing and polishing podcast content, but we’re not looking for someone who only knows how to cut clips together. This role is built for an editor who wants to seriously improve their craft and eventually take full ownership of projects.



You’ll work alongside experienced editors and creatives while developing your skills in YouTube editing, storytelling, pacing, VFX, motion graphics, sound design, and creative decision-making.



You don’t need to be an expert yet, but you should already have a strong foundation in editing and understand the fundamentals of text animation, rotoscoping or rotobrushing, audio balancing, sound effects, color correction, and motion graphics.



We’ll provide feedback, guidance, and mentorship, but our goal is to help you become a highly capable, independent editor who can eventually produce excellent work without needing constant supervision.



If you already have the fundamentals and are serious about becoming an exceptional editor, we’d love to hear from you.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Edit, clean, and polish approximately one podcast episode per week into a professional, high-quality final video.



Maintain a very high level of quality control throughout every project. Catch issues such as bad cuts, awkward pauses, syncing problems, spelling mistakes, audio inconsistencies, or sloppy frames before delivery.



Create animated intros, text overlays, visual callouts, motion graphics, and sound effects that improve the viewing experience.



Clean and balance dialogue, music, and sound effects so the final mix sounds professional.



Perform basic color correction and grading to maintain a clean and consistent look.



Work with senior editors and creatives to improve your storytelling, pacing, VFX, and YouTube editing skills.



Apply feedback quickly and accurately during revision rounds.



Gradually take more ownership of projects until you’re capable of managing the editing process independently.

title: Operations Manager (Remote) - Marketing Agency
description:
Job Description:




 is a dynamic and fast-growing marketing agency focused on empowering local businesses. With our core visual team in place, we are now seeking a strategic and driven Operations Manager to become the right hand to the founder.



This is not an administrative role—it is a key leadership position with immense growth potential. You will be the operational engine of the company, ensuring our team excels, our projects run flawlessly, and our hiring scales efficiently. You will directly manage day-to-day operations so the founder can focus on high-level strategy and business growth.



If you are a natural organizer, a proactive problem-solver, and thrive on building systems from the ground up, this is your opportunity to shape the backbone of a promising company.



Your Core Responsibilities:



Team & Project Management: Oversee the workflow of our visual team (designers, video editors). Implement and manage project management tools (Asana/Trello/ClickUp or any other platforms that works efficiently) to ensure all tasks are tracked and deadlines are met for our key launch goals.



Hiring & Onboarding Lead: Own the full hiring cycle for all future roles—from writing job posts and screening 50+ applicants to conducting first-round interviews. You will present only the top 2-3 vetted, exceptional candidates to the founder for a final interview.



Process & System Creation: Document and streamline our core workflows (content creation, client onboarding, hiring). Become the expert administrator for all our tools (Google Workspace, Canva Team, project management, password manager, etc).



Communication Hub: Manage the founder’s calendar, prioritize
s, and ensure clear communication flows between the founder and the team. Run daily/weekly check-ins to keep everyone aligned.



Strategic Support: Work directly with the founder to translate big-picture goals into actionable plans, identify bottlenecks, and drive operational efficiency as we scale.



Must-Have Requirements:



Proven Experience: 2-3+ years in an operations, project management, or executive support role, preferably in a marketing, agency, or startup environment.



Hiring Expertise: Demonstrable experience in screening candidates, conducting structured interviews, and managing a hiring pipeline. You must be an excellent judge of talent and character.



Tech & Tool Proficiency: High proficiency with Google Workspace, ClickUp/Asana/Trello, and Slack. Ability to quickly learn and administer new platforms (Canva, password managers, etc.).



Exceptional Communication: Flawless written and spoken English. You must be able to represent the company professionally and communicate clearly with both the team and candidates.



Proactive & Systematic Mindset: You don't wait for instructions. You anticipate needs, create order from chaos, and are obsessed with efficiency and clarity.



Leadership Vibe: You can manage workflows and diplomatically hold tea
mbers accountable without direct authority, earning respect through competence and organization.



Nice-to-Have:



Experience in a marketing or creative agency.



Basic understanding of social media management, design, or video production workflows.



Experience with budgeting or financial tracking.



How to Apply (Read Carefully):

To filter for true attention to detail, applications MUST begin with the subject line: "OPERATIONS ARCHITECT READY".



In your application
, please include:



Your updated CV/Resume.



A cover letter that answers this question: "A designer and a video editor are on a shared project but disagree on the priorities, causing a delay. What are your first three actions to resolve this and get the project back on track?"



Your answers to these two questions:



What does a "good hiring process" look like to you, from job post to offer?



Describe a time you implemented a new system or process that significantly improved team efficiency.



Your current monthly salary and expected salary for this full-time role.



Our Hiring Process:



Application Review (We will strictly filter for complete, thoughtful applications).



Initial Interview (30 mins): A conversation about your approach to operations and problem-solving.



Paid Test Project (3-4 hours): A practical task simulating real work (e.g., screening sample resumes, building a project plan).



Final Interview with the Founder.



We are moving quickly to build an exceptional team. If you are ready to take ownership and build with us, we look forward to your application.

description:
Visual Design Lead (Remote, Full-Time)



Company: 

Work Setup: Remote | Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Timezone Preference: Overlap with US business hours | Eastern Time (at least 3–4 hours)



We are 
, a new and growing marketing agency focused on helping local businesses thrive. As we build our core team, we are looking for a talented, detail-oriented, and creative Visual Design Lead to become the foundation of our visual brand.



This is a long-term, full-time remote role with significant growth potential. You will play a critical role in translating our brand voice and marketing strategy into clear, compelling, and conversion-focused visuals across all platforms.

This is not a “task-only” design role. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems, consistency, and outcomes, not just aesthetics.



What Success Looks Like in This Role (First 90 Days):

Our brand visuals feel cohesive, recognizable, and professional across all channels.

Core Canva templates are finalized and actively used by the team.

Social and ad creatives are delivered on time, on-brand, and iteration-ready.

Video content has a consistent visual style optimized for short-form platforms.

Founder communication becomes more strategic because execution is reliable.



Your Responsibilities:

Own and develop our visual brand identity. You will define, document, and maintain our color palette, typography, imagery style, and visual standards to ensure brand consistency across all assets.

Design high-impact marketing assets. This includes social media graphics (carousels, banners, posts), audit reports, presentation decks, digital ad creatives, and simple website graphics used across internal and client-facing touchpoints.

Build and manage reusable design systems. You will create scalable templates, asset libraries, and design frameworks in Canva to improve speed, quality, and repeatability.

Produce short-form video content. You will edit and produce Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok videos, handling clean cuts, text overlays, captions, and basic motion graphics.

Collaborate directly with the founder. You will translate concepts, briefs, and strategic direction into finished visuals while proactively suggesting improvements and creative ideas.

Prepare for future team leadership. As the company grows, you may help onboard, review, and guide junior designers to maintain standards and output quality.



Must-Have Requirements:

Portfolio is REQUIRED. Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered. Your portfolio must show social media graphics, brand identity work, and at least basic video samples.

Expert-level proficiency in Canva, plus strong working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

Strong short-form video editing skills using CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar tools.

Excellent visual judgment. You understand layout, spacing, hierarchy, typography, color theory, and can explain your design choices.

Clear written English communication skills. You can give and receive feedback professionally.

Highly dependable and self-managed. You meet deadlines, organize your workload, and communicate blockers early.

Stable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace.



Nice-to-Haves:

Experience in a marketing agency, startup, or fast-paced environment.

Familiarity with Webflow, Framer, or WordPress.

Understanding of creative performance for LinkedIn,
, and Instagram ads and organic posts.

Experience creating or following brand guidelines.



Work Style & Expectations:

You are comfortable working remotely with minimal hand-holding.

You value brand consistency over personal style.

You are open to feedback and iteration.

You think in terms of systems, templates, and scalability, not one-off designs.

You communicate progress clearly and proactively.



Growth & Opportunities:

Opportunity to become Head of Design as the company scales.

Increased ownership and leadership responsibilities over time.

Long-term role in shaping a growing brand from the ground up.



How to Apply:

To confirm you’ve read this entire post, start your application with the phrase “AUDIT READY.”

Please include:

Your updated CV/Resume

A link to your portfolio (required)

A short explanation of 1–2 design projects you’re most proud of and why

Your answer to: “What does brand consistency mean to you in practical terms?”
