1. Application Review (portfolio is critical)

2. Initial Short Interview (Zoom)

3. Paid Test Project (we compensate you for real work)

4. Final Interview & Offer

title: Amazon & Walmart Marketplace Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Amazon & Walmart Marketplace Manager / PPC Specialist to take ownership of the day-to-day management, advertising, optimisation, and growth of a CPG brand across Amazon and Walmart Marketplace.



The primary focus of this role will be PPC management, marketplace performance, listing optimisation, and overall channel growth. Amazon is already an established sales channel for the business, while Walmart Marketplace will need to be set up and launched from scratch. The successful candidate should be comfortable both optimising an existing marketplace operation and building a new marketplace channel from the ground up.



The ideal candidate should be capable of operating independently and effectively replacing much of the support traditionally provided by an external marketplace agency.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20+ hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon & Walmart Marketplace Management



Manage and optimise the brand's existing Amazon Seller Central account

Lead the end-to-end setup and launch of Walmart Marketplace — including account setup, catalogue creation, product listings, content, operational configuration, and launch readiness

Take ownership of marketplace performance, account health, listings, inventory, and day-to-day channel management across both platforms

Build, manage, and optimise PPC campaigns across Amazon Ads and Walmart Connect once the Walmart channel is live

Conduct keyword, search-term, competitor, and product-targeting research

Optimise campaign bids, budgets, placements, match types, negative keywords, and product targets

Monitor and improve key metrics including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, and advertising-attributed revenue

Identify opportunities to reduce wasted spend while increasing profitable marketplace growth

Optimise product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, attributes, and listing content

Recommend improvements to product imagery, A+ Content, storefronts, and other conversion-focused creative

Monitor listing suppressions, catalogue issues, account health, pricing, stock levels, and competitor activity

Support marketplace promotions, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and key retail events

Provide clear reporting and actionable recommendations on sales, advertising, conversion, and profitability



2. Marketplace Reporting & Analysis



Produce regular performance reporting across Amazon and Walmart

Track sales, advertising spend, profitability, conversion, traffic, and marketplace growth

Clearly communicate what happened, why it happened, and what action should be taken next

Identify trends and issues before they materially impact performance

Make proactive recommendations rather than waiting for instructions



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years of hands-on Amazon marketplace management experience; strong Amazon PPC experience with evidence of personally managing and optimising campaigns

Amazon: Strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central; experience with keyword research, listing optimisation, and marketplace SEO; strong analytical understanding of ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, conversion rates, and profitability

Walmart: Previous experience setting up and launching Walmart Marketplace accounts from scratch is strongly preferred; strong understanding of Walmart Seller Center, catalogue setup, listing creation, and marketplace operations; experience with Walmart Connect advertising strongly preferred

Analytical: Highly analytical and comfortable working with performance data; strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

Industry: Experience with CPG, food & beverage, grocery, or consumer brands strongly preferred

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English

Profile: Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of a channel rather than waiting for individual tasks; able to operate independently and replace much of the support typically provided by an external agency

Bonus: TikTok Shop management experience



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: HR Specialist/ (Full-Time, Remote – Philippines)
description:
Company Overview

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. The ideal candidate must be independent, empathetic, proficient in employee communication, and familiar with employee risk management. You need to be process-driven, meticulous, and capable of adapting to a fast-paced remote working environment. Candidates with Chinese language proficiency will be given priority consideration.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-cycle Recruitment: Publish job openings, screen resumes, conduct interviews, coordinate hiring processes, and complete talent matching according to department staffing demands.

2. Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage employee onboarding, job transfer, status adjustment, resignation and termination procedures; organize and file employee documents to ensure complete and standardized personnel files.

3. Performance Management: Assist in optimizing performance appraisal systems, organize regular performance evaluations, sort assessment data, follow up on performance feedback, and complete data statistics.

4. Employee Relations: Maintain daily communication with employees, respond to HR-related inquiries, properly handle daily employee relation issues, and build a positive team atmosphere.

5. Training & Employee Care: Organize employee onboarding training and deliver HR policy training; arrange one-on-one employee interviews and emotional counseling, track staff dynamics, and improve employee retention rate.



Qualifications & Requirements

1. Minimum 2 years of solid HR working experience, familiar with recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and performance management processes.

2. Proficient in employee relations management, skilled in one-on-one counseling, emotional guidance, staff care and training.

3. Strong data sorting ability, rigorous and detail-oriented in daily work.

4. Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills to communicate with all-level employees.

5. Self-motivated and responsible, capable of independently handling full-cycle HR tasks.

6. Proficient in Office software, able to make training materials and maintain employee relation records.

7. Must have backup internet such as prepaid WiFi/data for stable remote working.

8. Must have a power backup in case of power outages.

9. Shift arrangement: Day shift for the first month, then transfer to night shift permanently.



Application Guidelines

If you are interested in this position, please submit the following materials:

1. Your updated resume (resume link is acceptable).

2. Interested candidates please submit your application and fill out the questionnaire via the link below:

ue2fl6z2dmj.sg.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrlgzDguRc5jayVxeQLRnvW8Vc



Notice: Please mention in your application message that you have completed the questionnaire. We will conduct preliminary screening by combining your questionnaire information and resume. Candidates who pass the initial screening will be contacted via email for an interview invitation. Wish you all the best.



Company Information

Company Website:www.drayeasy.com/



Company Benefits

We provide a stable working environment and clear career growth. Your professionalism and dedication will be highly valued. Candidates with Chinese skills enjoy better development opportunities and priority in recruitment. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Care Specialist
description:
We are looking to hire immediately. This job posting will only be available for the next 48 hours. All applicants must complete take home assignment by Tuesday (Sept 15) 9AM Pacific Time. See here for the take home assignment:



Interviews will be scheduled for Thursday afternoon Pacific Time.



We're a fast-moving healthcare operations team that handles prior authorizations (PAs) for infusion clinic. We're building a team of sharp, hungry operators to help us do it at scale.



As a Care Specialist, you'll be on the front lines — initiating PA requests, verifying insurance benefits, navigating payer portals and phone systems, and documenting cases accurately in our internal platform. You'll work directly with our team leads and report into operations leadership.



Warning: this is not an easy job. The learning curve is steep and the pace is fast— every case you touch is a patient waiting on treatment. We'll train you on the content, but we can't train work ethic, attention to detail, or the drive to push through hard problems. If you want comfortable, this isn't it. If you want growth, you’ll fit right in.



What You'll Do

Initiate prior authorization requests with insurance payers via online portals and phone calls

Accurately document case details, call notes, and outcomes in our internal case management platform

Navigate complex payer phone trees and hold times without losing steam

Identify when cases hit non-standard situations and escalate or problem-solve proactively

Follow SOPs closely while flagging gaps or process improvement opportunities

Manage a live queue of cases across multiple statuses — nothing falls through the cracks



You're a Great Fit If You Are...

Hungry and self-driven

You don't wait to be told what to do next — you find the next task

You want to grow fast and take on more responsibility over time



Obsessively detail-oriented

You catch errors others miss - wrong codes, missing fields, inconsistent info

You don't submit work you're not sure about

You understand that one mistake in a PA form can delay a patient's treatment by weeks



A fast, independent learner

You can read a new SOP and execute it correctly within a few days

You ask smart clarifying questions before going down the wrong path

You're comfortable not knowing everything on day one and excited to learn



A creative problem-solver

When a case hits an edge case, you think before you escalate

You come to your manager with a proposed solution, not just a problem

You document what happened so the next person doesn't hit the same wall



Resilient and relentless

Hold times, rejections, and ambiguous situations don't demoralize you

You stay focused through repetitive tasks without cutting corners

Requirements

Strong written and spoken English - you'll communicate with US insurance reps and clinic staff

Comfortable working US business hours (EST or PST overlap required)

Tech-comfortable — you can navigate multiple browser tabs, portals, and spreadsheets simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment

What You Don't Need

A medical or clinical background — we'll teach you what you need to know about PAs and insurance. You just need to be a fast learner.

Years of experience — we care far more about how you think and how hard you work



What We Offer

Above-market starting pay — we pay more than most entry-level BPO or VA roles because we expect more

Performance bonuses — hit your targets, earn more. Hustle is rewarded directly

Formal 4-month review — we evaluate and adjust compensation fast, not on a yearly corporate clock

Solid career growth path — PA Agent ? Senior PA Agent ? Team Lead. We promote from within and we're growing very fast

Ground-floor opportunity — you're joining early. The people who build with us now are the ones who lead later

Fully Remote

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (Tech)
description:
Hey, I'm Giovanni! I'm looking for a long-form video editor to team up with me and grow my YouTube channel, TechGio. This is the most important hire I'm making for the channel. If you love clean, premium tech content and you're excited about AI, keep reading. I think you're going to like this one!



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



I work in tech sales, and TechGio started as me documenting my own path into the industry and helping others break in with no experience. That's still part of it, but the channel is expanding into something bigger: the AI and tech industry, the tools I actually use every day (Grok Bot, Claude, AI agents, and whatever comes next), and the behind-the-scenes of building my own AI startup while working full-time.



So the mix is: talking-head, screen recordings of real tools and workflows, and founder journey content. All long-form, all YouTube.



THE STYLE I'M GOING FOR



The best tech channels right now share a format: clean talking-head plus screen recordings that are actually easy to follow. Cursor highlights, smooth zooms, crisp on-screen text, diagrams that make technical ideas simple. Premium and calm, not flashy.



Channels that nail it:

• Chris Raroque (closest to the exact style I want)

• Nate Herk | AI Automation

• Alex Finn

• Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies



Three videos that show the exact look:









You can also check my channel to see how previous videos were edited: 



If you watch these and think "I can edit at that level," you're who I'm looking for. Please watch a few before you apply!



WHAT YOU'LL DO



I batch-film, so you'll get raw talking-head footage, screen recordings, and a short brief per video (hook, structure, key moments). From there, you own the edit:

• Trim and pace. Cut dead air and bad takes, keep the energy up. Retention is the job.

• On-screen text. Captions, callouts, key numbers, lists. Sharp and well-timed.

• Screen recordings. Zooms, cursor highlights, clean cuts between me and the screen.

• Simple motion graphics. Diagrams for AI concepts, tool highlights, transitions.

• Music, sound design, color, and final export.

• Revisions from my timestamped notes. Usually one round.



Deliverables: finished video plus organized project files.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



• Experienced with long-form YouTube. You've edited talking-head + screen recording content before and can show me published videos. Please don't apply if your portfolio is mostly Shorts, gaming, or events. Nothing against that work, it's just a different job.

• Passionate about AI and tech. You follow the space, or genuinely want to. It shows in the edit when the editor gets the content.

• You use AI in your workflow. Descript, auto-captions, AI features in Premiere or Resolve, whatever makes you faster and better. My whole operation runs on AI.

• Strong with text and motion. Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve plus After Effects (or equivalent).

• Fast and reliable. First cut within 48 hours of getting footage. 24 hours is the goal. If something is going to slip, I hear about it before it does.

• Willing to adapt and learn. The tech space moves fast and the channel will evolve with it. I want someone who grows with me, takes feedback well, and cares whether the video performs.

• Clear communicator. Fluent written English, responsive on Slack or WhatsApp, comfortable working async.



PAY AND WHAT YOU GET



$50–$100 per video depending on experience and quality. We start at 2 videos a week and grow from there.



This is a long-term partnership, not a one-off gig:

• Consistent volume that grows with the channel.

• Rate increases tied to quality and consistency. Good work gets rewarded!

• Tools covered. I'm open to paying for software, plugins, or assets you need.

• First look at everything that comes next: startup launch content, product videos, and more.

• A real seat at the table. I want your ideas on hooks, pacing, and style.



QUICK FACTS



• Paid per video: $50–$100

• 2 videos a week to start

• First cut within 48 hours (24-hour goal)

• Long-form YouTube only. No Shorts.

• Slack or WhatsApp for communication



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "GROK" so I know you read the whole thing.



Then send me:

1. 3 links to long-form YouTube videos you edited (talking-head + screen recording preferred) and exactly what you did on each.

2. Which of the reference videos above is closest to your style, and one or two sentences on why.

3. Your tools, including which AI tools you use.

4. How many 10–15 minute videos per week you can realistically deliver, and your typical first-cut turnaround.

5. Your rate per video.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit before we commit to anything, so you get paid either way.



I need portfolio links to consider you, so please don't skip those. Excited to see your work!



— Giovanni

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location:  Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

•  Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Google Ads, SEO & Growth)
description:
Cooper Roofing Inc.



Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Google Ads, SEO & Growth)







Location: Remote (Philippines preferred). Applicants must maintain at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours. Five to eight hours of overlap is ideal.







Lead the Marketing Growth of an Established Service Business

Cooper Roofing is an award-winning roofing company serving Greater Vancouver and the Lower Mainland. We are bringing our marketing operations in-house and looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Manager to lead measurable growth through Google Ads, SEO, conversion optimization, and marketing analytics.



This is not a Social Media Manager position. We already have one in place.



We need someone who can take ownership of our paid and organic search strategy, improve lead generation, strengthen attribution, and help build a scalable customer-acquisition system.



You will report directly to the Founder and CEO.



Key Responsibilities

Reactivate, manage, and optimize Google Ads using six years of historical campaign data.

Develop and lead technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO strategies.

Manage Google Local Services Ads and Meta Ads where appropriate.

Improve landing-page conversion rates through testing and optimization.

Manage GoHighLevel tracking, dynamic number insertion, number pools, UTMs, and nurture sequences.

Maintain accurate attribution between marketing spend, leads, sales, and closed revenue.

Own Google Business Profile optimization, review generation, and local reputation strategy.

Conduct competitor analysis across advertising, SEO, offers, and positioning.

Develop seasonal lead-generation campaigns for roofing demand cycles.

Provide clear SEO and development direction to our web developer.

Direct the Social Media Manager's output where it supports the wider marketing strategy.

Produce weekly reports connecting marketing performance to actual business results.

Present results, explain performance, and recommend next steps directly to the CEO.

What We're Looking For

Strong Google Ads and SEO experience is essential.



We are specifically looking for someone with:



Demonstrated experience independently managing and optimizing Google Ads.

Strong technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO knowledge.

A proven track record of generating qualified leads and revenue for a service-based business.

Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, conversion rates, ROI, ROAS, and revenue attribution.

Experience with conversion tracking, call tracking, Google Analytics, Search Console, and Google Business Profile.

Experience developing SEO strategies and directing web developers.

Experience with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear decisions.

Excellent written English and strong organizational skills.

Experience managing contractors, content creators, or other marketing team members.

Experience in roofing, construction, home services, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling, landscaping, or another local B2C service industry is highly valued.



Familiarity with JobNimbus, JustCall, Local Services Ads, structured data, AI-search optimization, or conversion-rate optimization is also an asset.



Who This Role Is Not For

This role is not primarily focused on:



Social media posting

Content scheduling

Graphic design

Influencer marketing

Community management

Brand-awareness campaigns without measurable lead-generation responsibility

We already have social media support.



We need someone whose strongest skills are Google Ads, SEO, analytics, attribution, and growing a service business through measurable digital marketing.



Pay and Benefits

Full-time independent contractor position.

Base salary: $1,000-$1,500 USD per month, paid bi-weekly, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.

Salary paid bi-weekly.

Thirteenth-month bonus for candidates based in the Philippines; an equivalent structure may be discussed for candidates located elsewhere.

Direct access to the Founder and CEO.

Access to six years of historical campaign data, an existing Social Media Manager, and a web developer.

Ongoing professional development and meaningful ownership of a major business function.

Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid skills assessment.

Applicants must consistently provide at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours.

Candidates working from the Philippines should be comfortable maintaining the required evening or overnight schedule long term.

Why Cooper Roofing?

We are looking for someone who wants genuine responsibility for business growth.



Success in this role will be measured by qualified leads, customer acquisition cost, revenue, and growth, not social engagement metrics.



If you have strong Google Ads and SEO experience and can demonstrate how your marketing work has helped a service business generate leads and revenue, we want to hear from you.



Cooper Roofing encourages applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Real Estate Appointment Setter & CRM Manager (Pre - Construction Sales)
description:
# Job Posting: Warm Caller, Appointment Setter & CRM Manager (Real Estate — Preconstruction)





*TO APPLY SEND US A 1-2 MINUTE VOICE MESSAGE INTRODUCTION*





## 🏠 About the Role

We're a Canadian real estate business specializing in **preconstruction townhomes and homes** across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), with a focus on Mississauga and Milton. We're looking for a sharp, motivated **Warm Caller / Appointment Setter / CRM Manager** to join our team and help connect qualified leads with real estate opportunities.



This is NOT a cold-call-into-the-void role — you'll be working warm/interested leads, booking appointments, and keeping our CRM organized and up to date. Full training provided — no real estate background required, but the traits below are non-negotiable.



## 💼 What You'll Be Doing

- Calling warm leads interested in preconstruction real estate in the GTA

- Booking qualified appointments that lead to closed deals

- Managing and updating our CRM — keeping lead statuses, notes, and follow-ups accurate and current

- Following up with leads through the pipeline (calls, texts, follow-up sequences)

- Working closely with our team to refine scripts and improve conversion



## 🕐 Schedule

- **8 hours/day, 6 days/week**

- Must be available to work **Eastern Time (Canada)** hours

- Full-time commitment — this is not a side gig



## 💰 Compensation

- **$1,000 CAD/month base salary**

- **+ $200 CAD per closed deal** that originates from an appointment you set

- Paid in **Canadian Dollars (CAD)**

- Uncapped upside — the more qualified appointments you set that convert, the more you earn on top of your base



## ✅ Requirements

- **Prior experience in cold/warm calling** — sales, appointment setting, or a similar outbound phone role

- **Master-level spoken English** — clear, confident, and easily understood by Canadian callers. This is one of the most important requirements for this role, since you'll be speaking directly with clients across the GTA.

- Comfortable and reliable working **Eastern Time hours**, 6 days a week

- Strong organizational skills — you'll be responsible for keeping the CRM clean and accurate, not just making calls

- Reliable internet connection, quiet call environment, and professional phone manner



## 🔥 Who We're Looking For

- **Hungry** — genuinely motivated to grow and earn more through performance

- **Disciplined** — shows up consistently, doesn't need to be micromanaged

- **Organized** — can manage a pipeline of leads without things falling through the cracks

- **Coachable** — willing to learn real estate/preconstruction knowledge from scratch through our training program



## 📩 HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

Applications without this will not be considered.



**Send a 1–2 minute voice message introducing yourself.** Tell us:

- Your name and where you're calling from

- Your relevant calling/sales experience

- Why you think you'd be a great fit for this role



We're listening for clarity, confidence, and energy — not a script. Just talk to us like you'd talk to a client.



---

*This is a long-term opportunity for the right person — we're building a team, not just filling a seat.*

title: Remote Sales & Customer Support Coordinator
description:
Descom Consultant is a Perth-based building inspection business seeking an experienced Sales & Customer Support Coordinator to join our existing team remotely.



You will handle customer enquiries, follow up on leads, prepare quotations and coordinate inspection bookings using our company phone system and Zoho CRM. Your main objective will be to convert enquiries into confirmed bookings while providing professional customer service and keeping our booking operations organised.



We are looking for someone who combines confident telephone sales skills with strong administration and attention to detail. You should be comfortable handling objections, following up consistently and helping customers take the next step—not simply answering calls and taking messages.





We provide the leads. You will not be required to generate your own leads.

Key responsibilities

• Manage enquiries and convert leads: Answer incoming calls, contact new enquiries, follow up outstanding quotations and respond through
, SMS and website enquiry channels. Understand customer requirements, explain suitable inspection services and help customers proceed with bookings. 

• Prepare accurate quotations: Collect property and inspection details, use our approved pricing and explain service inclusions and limitations. Seek approval for discounts, unusual requests and matters outside your authority. 

• Coordinate bookings and inspector schedules: Create, confirm, allocate and reschedule inspection appointments. Organise daily schedules and coordinate property access with customers, agents, owners, tenants and other relevant contacts. 

• Support customers throughout the process: Send confirmations and reminders, follow up outstanding information and payments, and assist with booking and report-delivery enquiries. Work with the team to handle concerns and complaints, escalating technical questions to the appropriate inspector. 

• Maintain accurate Zoho CRM records: Update customer details, call notes, quotations, booking information, deal stages and follow-up tasks. Manage assigned enquiries through to a clear won or lost outcome, with appropriate notes and handovers. 

• Work closely with the team: Communicate scheduling changes, access problems and customer concerns promptly. Take ownership of your assigned work while seeking support when needed. 





What we are looking for

• Proven phone-based sales and customer support experience, including following up enquiries, handling objections and converting leads into bookings or sales. 

• Clear spoken and written English, a professional telephone manner and the ability to explain information accurately. 

• Strong administration, organisation and attention to detail, with experience managing customer records, quotations or appointment schedules. 

• Experience using CRM software and online communication tools. Zoho CRM experience is preferred. 

• Reliability, consistent follow-through and the ability to work independently while coordinating with a remote team. 

Experience supporting Australian customers, or working in building inspections, property, trades or another appointment-based service business, will be an advantage.





You must have your own suitable computer, reliable internet connection, headset and a quiet, private workspace.



Training and support

We will provide service information, pricing guidance, documented procedures and access to our phone system and Zoho CRM.

An experienced team member will supervise your onboarding and provide support. As you demonstrate the required knowledge and accuracy, you will take greater ownership of routine quotations, bookings and customer enquiries within approved guidelines.



Performance will be assessed on bookings secured, enquiry-to-booking conversion, response times, completed follow-ups, booking accuracy and customer service quality.



Working arrangements

Your specific shift and initial paid weekly hours will be agreed before starting, within our 8 am–6 pm Monday–Friday Perth coverage window. This is a coverage window, not a requirement to work the entire ten-hour period each day.

Additional weekend shifts may become available in the future by agreement. Successful initial performance may lead to an ongoing full-time opportunity.

title: Looking for an Online Counselor or Therapist for Weekly 1-on-1 Sessions (Long Term)
description:
Hi! I am looking for someone to do weekly one-on-one online sessions with me. This is meant to be long term and ongoing, not a one-off.



THE SETUP



I am based in the Netherlands, so I am about 6 hours behind Manila. Sessions would be text (for now) of around 50 to 60 minutes, once a week, ideally the same slot each time. Your evening is my afternoon, so evenings your time work nicely.



WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY IS



You would be my regular counsellor. Each week we have a session and you lead the session. Concretely that means:



- Listening and helping me talk through what is going on in my life.

- Asking the questions I would not ask myself, and pointing out patterns you notice over time.

- Helping me turn vague stuff into one or two small, specific things to try before the next session, then checking in on them the week after.

- Suggesting practical techniques or exercises when they fit.

- Keeping short private notes so we have continuity and you remember where we left off. I do not want to re-explain my life every week.

- Someone who can keep me accountable



WHO I AM HOPING TO FIND



- Someone with a psychology, counselling, or clinical background. A PRC license (RPsy or RGC) is a plus, but real hands-on experience counts just as much. Clinical and consultancy experience is very welcome.

- Ideally a couple of years of actually sitting with clients, whatever the setting.

- Comfortable English conversation.

- A quiet, private space and decent internet.

- Someone easy to talk to. Honestly, fit matters more to me than a long CV.



WHAT I OFFER



- Steady weekly work, paid per session, on time, via Gcash or PayPal.

- No admin, no reports, no chasing clients. Just the session.

- Happy to commit long term if it clicks.



HOW TO APPLY



No formal cover letter needed, a normal message is fine. Just tell me:



1. A bit about yourself and how you like to work with people.

2. Your background, plus your license if you have one.

3. Your usual availability, Manila time.

title: Crypto BD Team Lead | DeFi Partnerships & Qualified Appointment Setting  Crypto BD Lead
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Towing and Roadside Assistance Dispatcher
description:
About Us

We are a U.S.-based towing company operating within the AAA Northeast network as an Independent Service Provider (ISP). Our company handles roadside assistance and towing services and has built a strong reputation for reliability and performance. We are now launching a dispatching company that will support towing companies and roadside providers across the United States. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term and become a key part of our operations team.



Your Role

As a Towing Dispatcher, you will be responsible for coordinating roadside assistance and towing services, ensuring jobs are completed efficiently, and maintaining clear communication with drivers and customers. You will start part-time and transition into a full-time role as you develop your skills and performance.



Key Responsibilities



Dispatch and coordinate tow truck drivers

Monitor job lifecycle (Dispatched → Enroute → On Scene → Completed)

Communicate with drivers and customers (calls, chat, updates)

Handle delays, reassignments, and escalations

Maintain accurate job notes and updates

Follow dispatch workflows and SOPs



What We're Looking For

-strong English communication skills (spoken and written)

-Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

-Good problem-solving and decision-making skills

-Comfortable handling urgent and high-pressure situations

-Reliable and detail-oriented



Experience in Any of the Following is a Major Advantage

-Dispatching (towing, trucking, logistics, or delivery)

-BPO voice account experience (customer support, call handling)

-Roadside assistance or towing operations

-Familiarity with dispatch systems, GPS tracking, or CRM tools



Work Setup:

-Remote (Work from Home)

-Start: Part-time (20–30 hours/week)

-Transition to Full-time (40 hours/week)

-Must be available to work U.S. hours (night shift PH time)



Compensation & Growth

Starting Training Rate: $3.00 – $4.00 per hour

This is a training rate to start. Your starting point within that range is based on the experience and skill level you bring in. This is not a flat rate — we believe in paying more for performance, and any increase is subject to review after your training period:



60–90 days: Performance review after training — rate increase based on quality, speed & reliability

Full-time transition: Higher base rate as you take on more responsibility + Performance-based bonus and incentives



How to Apply



1.Submit your resume and a 1–2 minute video where you answer this question:

"You have three jobs come in at almost the same time: a car blocking a busy intersection, a flat tire in a safe parking lot, and a lockout with a child inside the vehicle. How do you prioritize them and why?



2. Subject line: Your Next Towing Dispatcher – [Your Name]

You'll work independently, with AI tools supporting a large share of your replies.



What you'll do

 inbox — answering pre-sale questions, order status queries, complaints and escalations promptly and in a consistent brand voice (expected output: 30–40 tickets per hour with AI support).

-Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a busy queue independently.

-Analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable proposing process improvements.



What we offer



Competitive salary + KPI-based bonuses

Long-term, fully remote setup

Flexible schedule within agreed hours

Real growth opportunity as the company expands



To apply, send:



-Your resume

-A cover letter covering your customer service experience in e-commerce

title: SEO & Google Marketing Specialist — CPG Food Brand (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
Please start your reply with the key word below so we know you read the full posting — applications that skip this will not be considered. 



About the Company

We're a growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) food brand selling a specialty baking/dessert ingredient. Our product is sold direct-to-consumer online (Shopify) and in national retail stores, and we're now growing our presence on TikTok Shop. Our brand voice is fun, playful, bold, and trendy. We care about authenticity, in our product and in how we show up online — nothing customer-facing that comes out of this role should be AI-generated. Full company name and brand details will be shared directly with the candidate we move forward with.



This is not an entry-level "post a blog and hope" role. We're looking for someone who actually understands SEO and Google's tools, and can be honest with us about what's working and what isn't. Right now our online store gets very little organic (non-paid) traffic from Google — which means almost every improvement you make should be visible in the numbers. For the right person, that's the good kind of problem to have.



One thing to know before you apply: AI-powered research and SEO tools are fine to use in your process, but final content that ships to our site (product/blog copy, meta descriptions) needs to be human-written or human-edited to sound like us. See "How we use AI" below.



What you'll do:

- Own SEO for our Shopify store: keyword research, on-page optimization (product pages, collection pages, blog content), meta titles/descriptions, and internal linking

- Run technical SEO audits (site speed, mobile-friendliness, structured data, sitemap, crawl errors) and fix or flag issues

- Set up and monitor Google Search Console and GA4, and turn that data into a clear monthly report: what's ranking, what's driving traffic, what to do next

- Research keywords and competitors in our category to find realistic opportunities to rank

- Write or brief SEO-optimized content (product descriptions, blog posts, flavor/recipe pages) that supports both search rankings and our brand voice

- Coordinate with our other contractors (content/TikTok) so SEO content and social content reinforce each other rather than working in silos

- As this proves out, help us evaluate whether Google Ads (Search/Shopping/Performance Max) makes sense as a next channel, and if so, help set it up



Why this role matters:

Our TikTok presence drives awareness and TikTok Shop sales, but we're leaving Google search traffic almost entirely on the table right now. Someone who actually knows SEO could meaningfully grow free, ongoing traffic into our Shopify store — traffic that doesn't disappear when an algorithm changes or an ad budget runs out.



How we use AI:

We're fine with AI-assisted research, keyword clustering, and drafting tools as part of your process. But anything that actually ships to our website — product copy, blog posts, meta descriptions — needs to be human-written or human-edited to sound like us, not raw AI output.



What we're looking for:

- Real, hands-on SEO experience — you must provide examples of previous work (sites you've optimized, and the traffic/ranking results, ideally with before/after numbers)

- Comfortable with Google Search Console and GA4 — not just familiar with the names, but able to read them and act on what you see

- Solid on-page and technical SEO fundamentals (site speed, structured data, mobile-friendliness, internal linking)

- Keyword and competitor research skills

- Strong written English — you'll be writing or briefing content aimed at U.S. home bakers/consumers

- Honest and specific: if something isn't working, we want to hear that plainly, with a reason and a next step, not vague reassurance

title: Cover Letter Writer – Singapore PR & Citizenship
description:

## Responsibilities

* Adapt the writing style and structure based on each client's individual circumstances.

* Work with our internal team to clarify information or request additional details when necessary.

* Excellent written English with strong grammar, sentence structure, and proofreading skills.

* Ability to write in a natural, human, and personalized tone rather than using generic or overly templated language.

* Strong research and information-gathering skills.

* Ability to understand complex information and organize it into a compelling and logical narrative.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to distinguish between relevant information and details that do not add value to an application.

* Comfortable working with feedback and making revisions.

* Able to meet deadlines and manage multiple client profiles at the same time.

* Experience handling confidential client information.



## Preferred Qualifications



Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:



* Immigration or visa-related writing

* Singapore PR or Citizenship applications

* Personal statements or statements of purpose

* Legal or professional writing

* University admissions or scholarship applications

* Executive or professional profile writing

* Recruitment or resume writing

* Client-facing writing services



*Knowledge of Singapore's PR or Citizenship application process is a strong advantage but is not required if you have excellent writing and research skills.**



## What We Value



We are looking for someone who:



* Writes with clarity, sincerity, and purpose

* Can make a client's story compelling without sounding exaggerated

* Knows how to highlight strengths without making unsupported claims

* Can identify the "why this matters" behind a client's experience

* Avoids generic, repetitive, or AI-sounding language

Location: Remote

title: Project Manager — Real Estate Media (QC, Delivery & Client Communication)
description:
We're a real estate photography company in Canada. We shoot listings, our editors produce the photos, floor plans, videos and virtual tours, and we deliver them to real estate agents. You'd be the person who makes sure that whole process actually finishes properly, every day.



What you'll do



- Quality control. Check finished work before it goes out — photos, floor plans, videos, virtual tours. You're the last set of eyes.

- Deliver to clients. Send the finished job to the agent and make sure they have what they paid for.

- Talk to clients. Answer questions, follow up, keep them updated when something changes.

- Answer the phone. Inbound calls from agents — booking shoots, checking on orders, general questions.

- Handle SMS. Reply to customer texts.

- Keep the team moving. Chase our editors and photographers when something is late, missing, or unclear. Not managing them — just making sure nothing sits.



Two tools: our own platform (we'll train you — it's where jobs, media and delivery live) and GoHighLevel for calls and texts.



That's the whole job. No sales, no marketing, no editing, no admin work outside this.



The hours — read this part carefully



Our clients are in Alberta, Canada (Mountain Time). The phone has to be answered during their day, which means your shift is roughly 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time, Saturday and Sunday.



This is a permanent night shift on the weekends. If that doesn't work for your life, this role won't either — and that's completely fine. Please don't apply hoping it'll change.



What we need



- Strong spoken English. You'll be on the phone with Canadian clients daily.

- Clear written English for texts and
s.

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to take calls.

- Organized. You'll juggle a lot of jobs at once and nothing can quietly fall through.

- Comfortable telling a teammate their work needs redoing, politely.



What we don't need



- Real estate experience.

- Photography or editing skills.

- A degree.



We'll train you on everything specific to us. We care that you're dependable, easy to talk to, and that things don't get lost with you.



To apply



Send a short message with:



1. Your name and where you're based.

2. A voice recording (30–60 seconds) — just introduce yourself and tell us about a time you had to chase someone to get something finished. Any recording app is fine.

3. Confirm you can work 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM Philippine time.

4. Your monthly rate in USD.



The voice recording is the main thing. You'll be on the phone all day — we need to hear you.

title: Marketing Coordinator - marleys Dance Shoes
description:
Marketing Coordinator — marleys Dance Shoes



Part-time · Remote · 20 hrs/week · $8/hr Reports directly to the founder.



About marleys



We make comfortable leather dance shoes in northern Portugal for social dancers in Canada and the USA — swing, lindy hop, salsa, and other social dances. We've grown through in-person sales at dance events across Eastern Canada and a network of instructor ambassadors, and we're building out our digital channels now.



You don't need to be a dancer. You do need to work inside a brand voice that's already defined rather than defaulting to your own.



This is the first real marketing hire. We have channels running and data accumulating, but no system holding it together. Your job is to build that system and then run it.



A separate content creator handles video editing, carousels, and scripts. You plan and brief; they make. You won't be editing footage.



1. Audit the channels, then build the view



Start here. Audit our marketing channels and metrics — what we've run, across which channels, and how it performed.



Then build one view in Notion that captures campaign performance across every channel in one place.
, organic social, LinkedIn, anything else we run. One place I can open and see what's working.



This is a system, not a report. It should stay current as campaigns run, and it becomes the reference point for every planning decision after it.



2. Monthly message and strategy call



You and I sit down once a month and decide what we actually want to say to our audience.



Those messages then cascade. Each one becomes an
, a set of social posts, a LinkedIn post — adapted for how people read in each place, not pasted across all three. You plan that cascade into the calendar.



3. Plan for growth



Beyond the monthly messages, plan the content that grows the account: reel concepts, carousels,
 campaigns, tests worth running.



These ideas come from the data, not from vibes. Use what's worked for us historically — the patterns the audit surfaces — to outline what we should be doing next month. Then hand that off as briefs the content creator can work from.



4. Document everything and make it better



Every recurring thing you do gets written down as a process while you do it.



Then we improve it. I want each repetition to be a little faster and a little more automated than the last — we use Claude Code to build internal tooling, and over time the parts of this job that are mechanical should stop being done by hand.



You don't need to arrive knowing how to do this. I'll teach you. But you do need to be someone who notices "I've now done this the same way four times" and wants to fix it.



5. Approve, schedule, publish

You draft copy; I'm the approval layer. I review, you revise

Once approved, you schedule:
s, LinkedIn posts

When the content creator delivers, you schedule social

You have access to Help Scout and review incoming messages from social and support, so nothing sits unanswered



Build in a buffer for my review. "Waiting on approval" isn't a reason something shipped late.



What you get

- A weekly one-on-one to plan and review, plus the monthly strategy session

- An editorial brief covering our voice and formatting rules, with examples

- Visual direction for how we're building the brand and visual identity

- Access to our Notion and the documentation behind how things run

- Real teaching on the automation side if you want it



What we're looking for

Hard Skills

- 2+ years in marketing or content for a small brand or DTC company, with work you can show

- Comfortable with analytics. You can pull platform data, clean it, and find the pattern without being told what to look for. This is the core of the job

- Strong written English. Much of this is drafting in my voice for people who'll actually read it

- Notion — real fluency, since you'll be building in it

- Klaviyo or a comparable ESP; Shopify; Help Scout or similar helpdesk



Soft Skills

- Genuinely organized. You notice when something's filed wrong and fix it without being asked

- Self-directed. This role exists so these decisions stop landing on my desk

- Willing to work in Eastern Time



On AI: use it. We do, heavily. But everything here reaches a human — a customer
, a LinkedIn post. It has to read like a person wrote it. You're the judgment on top of the tool, not a pass-through for it.



To apply



Please note: Generic proposals or those put through AI without any personalization or a human looking at it will be immediately rejected.



1. Look at our Instagram and tell me in one paragraph what's working and what isn't. Be specific and honest — I'm not looking for compliments.

2. Describe a tracker or dashboard you've built — what went in it, and what decision it actually changed.

3. Take any short update and write it twice, once for
 and once for LinkedIn. Real or invented, a few lines each. I want to see that you understand that the writing will differ based on the professional audience of Linkedin and potential customers in
. 

4. One question about the business you'd want answered before building a marketing calendar.

title: Ecommerce Content & Influencer Marketing Specialist
description:
ABOUT MAGIMOMENTS



MagiMoments turns personal photos and ideas into personalized illustrated storybooks for families, partners, and pet owners. From a child's adventure to a couple's favorite memories or a pet's unique personality, we help people celebrate the relationships that matter to them.



We're a small, founder-led business looking for a hands-on marketer who can create compelling content, build relationships with relevant creators, and help turn interest into purchases.



Explore our product at (
).



THE ROLE



This is a remote, part-time opportunity for a Philippines-based specialist, starting with a paid 60-day pilot. Our goal is to build an ongoing working relationship with someone who can grow with the business.



We expect approximately 15–20 hours per week initially, with the opportunity to increase hours by mutual agreement as we gain traction.



You'll work directly with a founder and take ownership of content production, social publishing, creator outreach, and reporting. We're looking for someone who brings ideas, recommends priorities, and follows through independently.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



* Turn product footage, book images, testimonials, and website recordings into engaging short videos.

* Develop content ideas for families, couples, and pet owners, helping us identify which audiences and messages respond best.

* Write clear captions and strong opening hooks that show why someone would want a personalized book.

* Plan and publish Instagram content, 
 suitable posts for
. Recommend additional channels when there is a clear opportunity.

* Find relevant small creators across family, relationship, pet, and gifting audiences. Assess audience fit, manage outreach and follow-ups, and coordinate collaborations.

* Track creator deliverables, deadlines, content permissions, and approved costs.

* Handle routine comments and messages during agreed working hours, escalating order-related questions to us.

* Review available traffic and purchase data, explain what is working, and recommend the next experiment.



We'll agree on practical weekly priorities and deliverables, then adjust based on results and available hours. Paid advertising is not part of the initial scope.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



* Relevant hands-on ecommerce or consumer-brand marketing experience, ideally two or more years.

* Strong short-form video editing skills using CapCut, Premiere, or similar tools, plus familiarity with Canva.

* Clear, natural English writing and the ability to create engaging, audience-appropriate messaging.

* Experience finding and coordinating creators or influencers, not just scheduling social posts.

* Ability to connect content activity to website visits and purchases where tracking is available.

* Reliable communication, attention to detail, and comfort working independently with a small team.



Experience with gifts, keepsakes, personalized products, family products, pet brands, or other visually demonstrable consumer goods is especially relevant.



Your portfolio and personal contribution matter more than degrees or certificates. Shopify expertise is not required.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



We'll provide approved product assets, book imagery, starting footage, testimonials, product information, a test account, and appropriate access to our social accounts and available analytics.



You'll own editing, content planning, publishing, and creator coordination. We'll own pricing, fulfillment, technical tracking, and website changes. You can request specific additional footage or assets when needed.



PAY AND WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



* US $10 per hour.

* After a successful trial and confirmed tracking, earn $1 per qualifying paid printed copy attributed to approved campaigns you manage, including creator partnerships.

* Approximately 15–20 hours per week initially, with room to increase hours as the business gains traction.

* An initial paid 60-day pilot, with the intention of continuing as an ongoing role if we see a strong fit and positive results.

* The first two weeks are a paid trial.

* During the pilot, bonus eligibility begins on day 15. Qualifying copies must be fulfilled and not refunded; free samples and internal orders do not qualify. Full attribution and payment terms will be agreed before work begins and reviewed together when extending the role.

* Mostly asynchronous work, with a mutually agreed weekly 25–30 minute check-in during US Eastern business hours. No overnight shift is required.

* A concise Friday report covering completed work, hours, results, lessons, and next-week priorities. Meeting and reporting time is paid.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction and two relevant brands you have supported, explaining your responsibilities.

2. Links to three short videos you personally created or edited.

3. One campaign or creator-partnership example: what you did, the budget if available, and the results. Redacted examples are welcome.

4. Your weekly availability, earliest start date, and confirmation that the pay and expected hours fit your expectations.

5. A brief explanation of how you would approach your first week working with MagiMoments.
